I hope this email finds you well. I'm trying to remember all the movies I've rented from MediaVault over the past few years, or maybe even just the last year or so. My memory isn't what it used to be, you see, and I was chatting with my friend the other day about old movies we used to watch and I couldn't for the life of me recall if I'd rented a certain one from you folks or bought it somewhere else. It would be super helpful if you could send me a list of my rental history, or tell me how I can access it myself. I'd prefer a list if possible.

Thank you for your help.
Wilma Richards

subject: Availability of 'Games' Category Films
body:
To Whom It May Concern,

I am writing to inquire about the current selection of films available within your 'Games' category. I have previously rented titles such as 'ICE CROSSING', 'MONSOON CAUSE', and 'DWARFS ALTER'. Could you please provide an updated list or confirm the availability of your full inventory under this specific classification?

My interest lies primarily in the aforementioned genre, and I would appreciate any information regarding new additions or restocked titles.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
Howard Fortner

subject: Do you sell popcorn?
body: Hi there, just wondering if your Store 2 location sells any snacks like popcorn or candy while we rent movies? Thanks!

subject: Lost sunglasses?
body: Hello, I visited your Store 1 yesterday afternoon and think I might have left my sunglasses behind. Do you have a lost and found? They're black Ray-Bans.

subject: Order #MV2023-456
body: Dear MediaVault, I placed an order for a custom vinyl record last week and haven't received a shipping update. Could you please check on order #MV2023-456 for me? Thanks!

subject: Holiday Hours
body: Quick question: Are you guys open on Labor Day? Trying to plan ahead for some movie rentals.

subject: Selling Used DVDs?
body: Hi, I have a bunch of old DVDs I'm looking to get rid of. Does MediaVault (Store 2) buy used DVDs or have any kind of trade-in program?

subject: Video Game Rentals?
body: Just curious if you rent video games too, or just movies? Been looking for somewhere to get some PS5 games.

subject: Cartoons for kids?
body: My kids want to know if you have any new cartoons to rent? They like the ones with talking animals. Thanks!

subject: Bathroom facilities
body: Good morning, I was wondering if MediaVault Store 1 has a public restroom available for customers? It's always good to know!

subject: Are you open in the snow?
body: With all this snow, are you still open today at Store 2? Don't want to make the trip if you're closed.

subject: Do you have customer Wi-Fi?
body: Hello, just a quick question. Does your Store 1 location offer free Wi-Fi for customers while they browse or wait? Thanks for letting me know.

subject: Parking at Store 1
body: Hey, what's the parking situation like at your Store 1 location? Is there a dedicated lot or is it street parking only?

subject: Pet policy?
body: I have a small, very well-behaved dog. Is MediaVault Store 1 pet-friendly, or do I need to leave him at home when I come to rent?

subject: Birthday Parties
body: Would it be possible to host a small birthday party at your Store 2 location? My son loves movies and it would be a unique idea!

subject: Is this the right email?
body: Hi, is this the correct email for MediaVault Store 1 customer service inquiries?

subject: Thanks for the great garden!
body: Just wanted to say thank you for the beautiful community garden you maintain next to your building. It's truly a lovely spot in the neighborhood. Keep up the great work!

subject: Gift Cards
body: Do you offer gift cards for MediaVault rentals? I'd like to get one for a friend's birthday.

subject: Rewards program?
body: I'm a frequent renter at your Store 2 location. Do you have any kind of loyalty or rewards program for regular customers?

subject: Returning to a different store?
body: If I rent a movie from Store 1, can I return it to the other MediaVault location (Store 2)? Or do I have to bring it back to the original store?

subject: Do you sell cereal?
body: This might be a weird question, but do you guys sell cereal like Froot Loops? My kid insists on having some for our movie night. Store 2.

subject: Directions to Store 1
body: Could you please provide the best driving directions to your Store 1 location from the downtown area? I always get a bit turned around.

subject: Open late?
body: Hey, are you guys open late tonight at Store 1?

subject: Music CDs
body: Do you also rent music CDs at your Store 2 location, or is it strictly movies and TV shows?

subject: Just checking in
body: Hi there. I wus just checking to see if you recieved my last email about the thing. I dont recall what I sent but I think it was importent. Please confirm for store 1. Thanks.

subject: Community Meeting Space?
body: Hello, our local book club is looking for a small, quiet space to meet once a month. Would MediaVault Store 2 consider allowing us to use a corner of your store for an hour or so?

subject: Any events planned?
body: I heard a rumor you might be hosting a retro movie marathon or some kind of community event soon at Store 1. Is there any truth to that, or a calendar of events available?
